description: Use this when the user asks how good their supplement stack is or how to improve it. Returns the signed-in user's StackScore with Quality, Value, Goals and Dosage ratings and coaching recommendations. Pass category to get a single category.

category.description: Optional category filter: 'quality', 'value', 'goals', or 'dosage'. Omit to get all categories.

name: suppco_get_stack_score
title: Get my StackScore
